test_name: ABC challenge personal record missing from menu - 44837c26-c7f3-49bd-ac0d-de5eb4b34042
summary: Pass because ABC's challenge details now show the YOUR BEST marker for slow, mid and Top Dog times, and putting the bar back into the state the old code left it in hides the marker again. This puts back the earlier session's fix: a record slower than Top Dog sent the bar a state name that doesn't exist, so the marker stayed invisible, and a record slower than 2:00 also got a zero-width marker. Other challenges (Aggressor, Hit & Run, 7 Strikes) still show their record.
instructions:
TASK: You can't see your personal record in the challenge ABC

DESCRIPTION:
every other challenge's personal record does show, and in ABC when you do beat your personal record it says "new personal record" but you don't see it in the menu

REQUEST (from Amit):
@Big Sys  dispatch jude again, it already fixed this issue but we had a problem with the workflows commit+push+pr, now it's okay so just put the changes in again

EXTRA (from the card):
Amit says this issue was already fixed once by jude but a workflow problem with commit+push+PR lost the changes, and asks to reapply the same fix now that the workflow is working again.

JOB TYPE:
BUG FIX - labeled 'Bug' and describes personal record not showing for the ABC challenge when it should

GAME MODE:
SINGLEPLAYER - card has the 'SinglePlayer' label
verified: Real Scenario Details panel scorebar, ABC best 2:30 and 1:00: node state complete, Your Best marker alpha 1, fill 0.214 / 0.750, YOUR BEST text shown

Standalone Scorebar for ABC 0:30 (Top Dog), Aggressor 4:30, Hit & Run 3:22, 7 Strikes 33: YOUR BEST visible with non-zero fill
SetState("completed") is rejected by the node (logs 'State completed not found in Scorebar') and keeps the previous state
